scope: Supported bounded normal-exit settlement defect and product-selection preparation; no general solver qualification

findings.basis: Both parent-owned live non-solver helper receipts show assigned=True, return_code=0, initial active=1. Second receipt shows subsequent active=0 without preemptive termination. Current _settle immediately sets settlement_required=True and terminates on any initial nonzero active count; the flag remains true after zero is reached. launch_case therefore reports evidence_complete=False for that observed transient condition.
findings.limit: Receipts establish one normal-exit observation pattern only, not ANSYS behavior, descendant success, timeout cleanup or true persistent-child settlement.

proposed_correction_contract: Set a single monotonic settlement deadline using the existing5-second polling allowance. Clean return means return_code exactly0, timed_outFalse and no launch/wait errors.

For clean return, query active and allow natural1-or-more→0 settlement within that existing deadline, polling at the existing0.01-second interval. Do not set settlement_required or terminate merely because the first clean-exit sample is nonzero.

If verified active reaches0 naturally, close owned handles; mark owned_processes_remaining0 and preserve settlement_requiredFalse. A query/close exception remainsINCOMPLETE and must retain uncertainty.

If activity persists through deadline or a query fails, mark cleanup-required, perform only owned termination and verify zero where possible; never reset cleanup-required to false after forced termination. Retain supervisor token/seat if zero cannot be established. Any further cleanup wait must be explicitly bounded and accounted, never silently extend fixed300-second solver or1800-second overall limits.
Timeout, failed start/wait, nonzero return and preexisting errors must not be converted to complete by the grace path. Preserve actual errors, raw bytes and ownership information.
required_tdd_cases: Mock clean return0 with active samples[1,0]: no terminate call, closed=True, ownedremaining0, settlement_requiredFalse and evidence_completeTrue. Use fake time; no native helper required for regression.
Mock clean return0 with active0 immediately: unchanged success.
Mock activity persistent until deadline: forced cleanup, incomplete even if termination subsequently reaches0; no extra canary attempt.
Mock query failure during grace and close failure after zero: incomplete with exact exception/retained ownership; no release-as-success.
Mock timed-out or failed/nonzero return with eventual zero: incomplete; clean grace cannot mask failed execution.
Existing invalidUTF8, no-overwrite and owned-token settlement tests remain required.

product_selection.basis: Official v261 product-selection documentation states ANSYS261_PRODUCT selects product when command-level MAPDL is issued; ansys denotes Mechanical Enterprise. Current runner has no-p and Popen inherits process environment.
conditions: Parent driver records ANSYS261_PRODUCT=ansys as exact execution environment evidence and ensures the same value in the actual launching process before every attempt. No frozen argv change is necessary.

External preflight validates the requested product alongside reviewed executable/hash/profile and records the effective environment source. No launcher profile is used by this direct executable route.

Observed native license identity/checkout evidence remains required to establish the actual acquired product; a requested environment value and lmstat counts alone do not prove checkout or exclusive ownership.
No weakening of fixed numerical criteria, attempt count,300/1800 limits or uncertain-seat retention.

actions: Read-only source/receipt inspection only; no code edits, helper/solver launch, provider call or process termination. Private receipt saved and read back.
